translations.translatedText: # Monday 8.8.2022
Finland's reception system. The price of fuels. Train traffic. Museum visits. Weather forecast.
TV's Clear News has a summer break 6.6.–12.8.
Read and listen to the radio broadcast here.
## Reception centres
![Room with bunk beds and a table with chairs.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_336/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-924127622265695070a/1646421772)
Open image viewer
A reception centre in Helsinki. Photo: Mårten Lampén / Yle
Many people are now seeking protection from Finland. There are now more clients in Finland's reception system than ever before.
The Finnish Immigration Service says that there are over 37,000 people in the reception system. That is more than, for example, during the 2015 refugee crisis.
The number has been increased by Ukrainians who have fled the war. Over 35,000 Ukrainians have submitted an application for temporary protection in Finland. Many of them are mothers and children.
## The price of fuels
![Petrol station price sign, behind it a man cycling.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6606,h_3698,x_0,y_688/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-99182062f1100903c36/1669550424)
Open image viewer
Fuel prices have fallen. Mostly petrol and diesel now cost a little over 2 euros a litre. Photo: Sara Aaltio / Yle
The price of fuel has continued to fall. The price per litre of diesel has already fallen below 2 euros in a few places.
For over 5 months petrol or diesel has not been available for under 2 euros a litre. The price of petrol is now a little over 2 euros a litre.

The price of petrol and diesel has fallen, because the government has reduced the renewable fuel distribution obligation. The price is also lowered by the fact that buying fuel has decreased because of the high price.
## Train traffic
![Railway bridge in Lempäälä.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4242,h_2386,x_0,y_441/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-99170962f0f0b9ec79c/1659957654)
Open image viewer
Someone may have committed vandalism on the cables on this railway bridge in Lempäälä. Photo: Jani Aarnio / Yle
VR's train traffic was cut off for many hours on Monday morning and during the day between Tampere and Riihimäki. Train traffic was interrupted, because a fault occurred in the electricity cables.
The Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency says that the cause of the cable fault may be vandalism. Someone or some people may have damaged cables that control the equipment of the railway line.
The Transport Infrastructure Agency has made a crime report about the matter to the police. Train traffic between Tampere and Riihimäki started running again in the afternoon.
## A busy summer for museums
![A museum card being shown to a reader device.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5333,h_2999,x_0,y_498/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-98942262e9024bbcc4b/1659438858)
Open image viewer
The museum card gives access to many museums in Finland. The museum card is popular. Photo: Antti Haanpää / Yle
Finns have visited museums a lot this summer. More people have visited museums than before the corona time.
Many Finns now want to go to museums and events after a long break. People have also returned to, for example, Helsinki's big museums. On summer holiday Finns also travel a lot.
The museum card, that is, an annual pass that gets you into many museums, has also greatly increased Finns' enthusiasm for visiting museums.
## The weather
![Tuesday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12568175)
Open image viewer
On Tuesday it is mostly dry, that is, no rain falls.
On Tuesday in the south and central part of the country it is dry, that is, no rain falls. The cloudiness varies.
In the north there is a lot of cloud and in places there will be rain showers.
The temperature in the southern and central part of the country is between 20 and 23 degrees. In the north the temperature is between 15 and 21 degrees.
